Ways to Pay
Customer Service MID Charges & Services
Electric usage
Based on how much electricity is used during the billing period.
Service Fee
Covers costs such as maintaining power lines,
substations and electric meters, and providing customer
service.
Capital Infrastructure Adjustment (CIA)
The revenue yielded from the CIA will go towards
deferring future debt and paying down existi debt.
Environmental Energy Adjustment (EEA)
The revenue yielded from the EEA is used to recover
the portion of the costs attributable to achieving
mandated targets of renewable energy and recover
costs related to Greenhouse Gases Mandates. The EEA
will be true up annually.
Late payment penalty
A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.

Ways to Pay
Customer Service MID Charges & Services
Electric usage
Based on how much electricity is used during the billing period.
Service Fee
Covers costs such as maintaining power lines,
substations and electric meters, and providing customer
service.
Capital Infrastructure Adjustment (CIA)
The revenue yielded from the CIA will go towards
deferring future debt and paying down existing debt.
Environmental Energy Adjustment (EEA)
The revenue yielded from the EEA is used to recover
the portion of the costs attributable to achieving
mandated targets of renewable energy and recover
costs related to Greenhouse Gases Mandates. The EEA
will be true up annually.
Late payment penalty
A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.

Ways to Pay
Customer Service MID Charges & Services
Electric usage
Based on how much electricity is used during the billing period.
Service Fee
Covers costs such as maintaining power lines,
substations and electric meters, and providing customer
service.
Capital Infrastructure Adjustment (CIA)
The revenue yielded from the CIA will go towards
deferring future debt and paying down existing debt.
Environmental Energy Adjustment (EEA)
The revenue yielded from the EEA is used to recover
the portion of the costs attributable to achieving
mandated targets of renewable energy and recover
costs related to Greenhouse Gases Mandates. The EEA
will be true up annually.
Late payment penalty
A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.

A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.

Ways to Pay
Customer Service MID Charges & Services
Electric usage
Based on how much electricity is used during the billing period.
Service Fee
Covers costs such as maintaining power lines,
substations and electric meters, and providing customer
service.
Capital Infrastructure Adjustment (CIA)
The revenue yielded from the CIA will go towards
deferring future debt and paying down existing debt.
Environmental Energy Adjustment (EEA)
The revenue yielded from the EEA is used to recover
the portion of the costs attributable to achieving
mandated targets of renewable energy and recover
costs related to Greenhouse Gases Mandates. The EEA
will be true up annually.
Late payment penalty
A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.

Ways to Pay
Customer Service MID Charges & Services
Electric usage
Based on how much electricity is used during the billing period.
Service Fee
Covers costs such as maintaining power lines,
substations and electric meters, and providing customer
service.
Capital Infrastructure Adjustment (CIA)
The revenue yielded from the CIA will go towards
deferring future debt and paying down existi debt.
Environmental Energy Adjustment (EEA)
The revenue yielded from the EEA is used to recover
the portion of the costs attributable to achieving
mandated targets of renewable energy and recover
costs related to Greenhouse Gases Mandates. The EEA
will be true up annually.
Late payment penalty
A late fee of 1.5% or a minimum of $5.00 will be
assessed on any unpaid balance after the due date.
Power Cost Adjustment
An adjustment that takes into account variances in
MID’s power supply costs not included in electric rates.
If the monthly PCA charge is determined to be zero, it
will not be reflected on electric bills.
Billing dispute procedure
If you believe your bill is wrong, please request an
explanation by calling MID at (209) 526-7337 within 5
days of receiving your bill. After your call, if you still
believe your bill is wrong, you may request an in-person
hearing. MID will not disconnect your service while an
investigation of your bill is pending.
Electric Service Rules and Rate Schedules
Customers can get a copy of the electric service rates
and rules at www.mid.org.
Deposit
A deposit is required for all new services. A deposit or
additional deposit may be required if bills are not paid on
time, or if a service is disconnected for non-payment.
Please see Deposit MID Fee Schedule at www.mid.org.
